metadata.name: chiefstaker
metadata.description: Token staking with time-weighted rewards. Supports both SPL Token and Token 2022. Uses Borsh enum discriminators (single u8 variant index), NOT Anchor 8-byte sighashes.

instructions.name: initializePool
docs: Initialize a new staking pool for a token mint (SPL Token or Token 2022).
Signer must be a recognized authority for the mint (mint_authority, metadata update_authority, or pfee SharingConfig admin).
Optional remaining accounts: Metaplex metadata PDA or pfee SharingConfig PDA for authority proof.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Authority / payer (must be mint_authority, metadata update_authority, or pfee admin)

instructions.name: stake
docs: Stake tokens into the pool. Creates user stake account if needed.
Preserves maturity percentage when adding to existing stake.
Requires the PoolMetadata PDA (increments member_count on a new stake; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata).

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metadata PDA (required; member_count is incremented on a new stake; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata)

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Unstake tokens from the pool (direct unstake).
Only available when pool has no cooldown configured.
Claims pending rewards and redistributes stranded rewards.
A full unstake closes the user stake account.

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program (required; for legacy account reallocation)

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metadata PDA (required; member_count is decremented on a full-unstake close; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata)

instructions.name: claimRewards
docs: SOL is transferred from pool PDA lamports to user.

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program (optional, for legacy account reallocation)

instructions.name: depositRewards
docs: Deposit SOL rewards into the pool (permissionless).
Transfers lamports from depositor to pool PDA and triggers sync.

instructions.name: syncPool
docs: Sync/rebase the pool to prevent sum_stake_exp overflow (permissionless crank).
Should be called periodically to keep the pool operational.

instructions.name: syncRewards
docs: Sync rewards sent directly to the pool PDA (permissionless crank).
Use when SOL is sent directly to the pool PDA (e.g., from pump.fun).
Detects new lamports via last_synced_lamports delta.

instructions.name: updatePoolSettings
docs: Each field is optional; only provided fields are updated.
Max caps: lock_duration <= 365 days, cooldown <= 30 days.

instructions.name: transferAuthority
docs: Transfer pool authority to a new address.
Setting to Pubkey::default() (all zeros) renounces authority irreversibly.

instructions.name: requestUnstake
docs: The requested coins stop earning rewards immediately (removed from pool
weight) and their already-earned rewards are settled and paid out now.
Only the token transfer is deferred to completeUnstake.
Only one pending request at a time.

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program (optional, for legacy account reallocation)

instructions.name: completeUnstake
docs: Complete unstake after cooldown has elapsed.
Delivers the frozen tokens from the vault to the user (reward settlement
already happened at requestUnstake). A full unstake closes the account.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metadata PDA (required; member_count is decremented on close; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata)

instructions.name: cancelUnstakeRequest
docs: Cancel a pending unstake request, restoring the frozen coins to the
active staking position (re-grants weight; re-added tokens get a fresh
reward snapshot so they earn no cooldown-period rewards).

accounts.name: owner
docs: User / owner (pays rent for legacy account reallocation)

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program (optional, for legacy account reallocation)

instructions.name: closeStakeAccount
docs: Close a zero-balance user stake account to reclaim rent.
Account must have zero staked amount, no pending unstake request, and no residual unclaimed rewards (>= 1 lamport). Sub-WAD dust is forgiven.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metadata PDA (required; member_count is decremented on close; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata)

instructions.name: deprecatedSlot13
docs: DEPRECATED: Slot 13 reserved for ABI compatibility (was FixTotalRewardDebt).

instructions.name: setPoolMetadata
docs: Set (create or update) pool metadata for explorer display (permissionless).
Derives name from Token 2022 mint metadata extension: "<token name> Staking Pool".
Creates the metadata PDA if it doesn't exist. member_count preserved across updates.

instructions.name: takeFeeOwnership
docs: Take fee ownership: set pool as sole fee recipient and revoke authority (permissionless crank).
Prerequisite: fee sharing authority must already have been transferred to the pool PDA.
Sets pool PDA as sole shareholder (100% / 10000 bps), then revokes fee sharing authority (irreversible).

accounts.name: pool
docs: Pool account (PDA: ["pool", mint]); CPI signer and writable payer

accounts.name: coinCreatorVaultAuth
docs: AMM creator vault authority PDA: ["creator_vault", sharing_config]

instructions.name: stakeOnBehalf
docs: Stake tokens on behalf of another user (beneficiary).
Staker provides tokens and pays rent; beneficiary receives the staking position.
Beneficiary does NOT need to sign.
Requires the PoolMetadata PDA (increments member_count on a new stake; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata).

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: Beneficiary (receives staking position, does NOT sign)

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metadata PDA (required; member_count is incremented on a new stake; an uninitialized account is tolerated for pools without metadata)

instructions.name: fixStakeAccount
docs: Fix a user's stake account corrupted by the add-stake blending bug.
Sets exp_start_factor and reward_debt to correct values, updating pool aggregates.

accounts.name: programData
docs: ProgramData account (derived from program_id via BPFLoaderUpgradeable)

instructions.name: migrateStake
docs: Migrate a stake position from one owner to another (clean 1:1 transfer).
Destination user stake must be empty; all time/maturity/reward state is preserved.
Pool aggregates and member_count are unchanged. Rejects if source is empty, has a
pending unstake request, or new_owner == source_owner; or if destination already exists.

accounts.name: sourceUserStake
docs: Source user stake (PDA: ["stake", pool, sourceOwner]); will be closed

accounts.name: sourceOwner
docs: Source owner: signs, pays destination rent, receives source rent refund

accounts.name: destinationUserStake
docs: Destination user stake (PDA: ["stake", pool, newOwner]); must be empty

accounts.name: newOwner
docs: New owner pubkey (no signer required, mirrors stakeOnBehalf)

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint address (SPL Token or Token 2022)

fields.name: rewardVault
docs: DEPRECATED: No longer used (pool PDA holds SOL directly). Retained for layout compatibility.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin authority who initialized the pool

fields.name: totalStaked
docs: Total tokens staked (raw amount, not WAD-scaled)

fields.name: sumStakeExp
docs: Sum of stake_i * e^(start_time_i / tau) as U256 little-endian bytes (WAD-scaled)

fields.name: tauSeconds
docs: Time constant in seconds (e.g., 2592000 for 30 days)

fields.name: baseTime
docs: Base time for rebasing (Unix timestamp). All exp_start_factors are relative to this.

fields.name: lastUpdateTime
docs: Last time rewards were updated (Unix timestamp)

fields.name: lastSyncedLamports
docs: Last known lamport balance (for sync_rewards to detect new deposits)

fields.name: lockDurationSeconds
docs: Lock duration in seconds after staking before unstake is allowed (0 = no lock)

fields.name: unstakeCooldownSeconds
docs: Unstake cooldown period in seconds (0 = direct unstake, >0 = requires RequestUnstake flow)

fields.name: initialBaseTime
docs: Original base_time before first rebase (0 = no rebase has occurred). Used for legacy account migration.

fields.name: totalRewardDebt
docs: Sum of all active users' reward_debt values (WAD-scaled). Used to compute stranded rewards from pool state alone. Starts at 0 for existing pools.

fields.name: totalResidualUnpaid
docs: Total lamports owed to residual claimants (fully-unstaked users with unclaimed rewards). Tracked separately from totalRewardDebt because residual users have amount=0.

types.name: UserStake
docs: Size: 178 bytes (legacy accounts at 153, 161, or 177 bytes are lazily reallocated).

fields.name: expStartFactor
docs: e^((stake_time - base_time) / tau) at time of staking (WAD-scaled). Used to track contribution to sum_stake_exp.

fields.name: rewardDebt
docs: Reward debt snapshot for pending reward calculation (WAD-scaled). When amount > 0: encodes acc_rps snapshot at last position restructure. When amount == 0: reinterpreted as unclaimed WAD-scaled rewards from a full unstake.

fields.name: unstakeRequestAmount
docs: Pending unstake request amount (0 = no pending request)

fields.name: lastStakeTime
docs: Timestamp of most recent stake deposit (for lock duration checks). Falls back to stake_time when 0.

fields.name: baseTimeSnapshot
docs: Pool base_time when exp_start_factor was last calibrated. 0 = legacy account (pre-rebase-aware).

fields.name: totalRewardsClaimed
docs: Cumulative SOL rewards claimed by this user (lamports). Defaults to 0 for legacy accounts.

fields.name: claimedRewardsWad
docs: Cumulative WAD-scaled rewards already paid for the current position. Used for frequency-independent claims: pending = full_entitlement - claimedRewardsWad. Reset to 0 on stake/unstake. Defaults to 0 for legacy accounts.

fields.name: unstakeRequestSettled
docs: 1 when the pending unstake request was created under the settle-at-request flow (frozen coins already removed from the pool). 0 = no request, or a legacy in-flight request from before this upgrade. Cancel/Complete branch on this to avoid double-restoring or double-removing legacy requests. Defaults to 0 for legacy accounts.

types.name: PoolMetadata
docs: Pool metadata account for explorer display.

fields.name: tags
docs: UTF-8 tags, zero-padded (8 slots of 32 bytes each)

fields.name: memberCount
docs: Active staker count. The metadata PDA is a required account on stake/unstake/close, so this stays exact (incremented on a new stake, decremented on close).

errors.name: InvalidMintProgram
errors.msg: Invalid mint - must be Token or Token 2022

errors.name: StakeLocked
errors.msg: Stake is locked - lock duration has not elapsed

errors.name: CooldownNotElapsed
errors.msg: Unstake cooldown period has not elapsed

errors.name: CooldownRequired
errors.msg: Pool requires RequestUnstake flow, not direct Unstake

errors.name: PendingUnstakeRequestExists
errors.msg: Must cancel existing unstake request first

errors.name: CooldownNotConfigured
errors.msg: Pool has no cooldown configured - use direct Unstake instead

errors.name: AccountNotEmpty
errors.msg: User stake account still has balance or pending requests

errors.name: UnsupportedMintExtension
errors.msg: Token mint has a dangerous extension (PermanentDelegate, TransferHook, etc.)

errors.name: MissingSystemProgram
errors.msg: System program required for legacy account reallocation

errors.name: RewardDebtExceedsBound
errors.msg: New total_reward_debt exceeds maximum accumulated rewards

errors.name: ResidualRewardsPending
errors.msg: Claim residual rewards before cancelling a full unstake request

errors.name: SelfMigrateNotAllowed
errors.msg: Cannot migrate a stake position to its own owner

errors.name: RemainingStakeBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Partial unstake would leave remaining stake below pool minimum

errors.name: ResidualRewardsUnclaimed
errors.msg: Claim residual rewards (ClaimRewards) before staking into this account again
